# llm.transcribe/v1

A model writes down what's said in audio. Every call names its model as `provider/model`: a provider the app's admins added in Settings → LLM, a slash, and
that provider's own id for the model. Shared types (`File`, `Usage`, `ModelInfo`, `Job`, the errors) are in
[`pocketone.dev/ext/contracts/llm`](https://github.com/pocketonehq/pocketone/blob/main/ext/contracts/llm/llm.go).

A wire contract at `/api/_c/llm.transcribe/v1` ([transcribe.go](https://github.com/pocketonehq/pocketone/blob/main/ext/contracts/llm/transcribe/v1/transcribe.go)), one provider. The
[llm](https://pocketone.dev/docs/extensions/llm/extension) extension provides it, over Vultr, Cloudflare Workers AI, OpenRouter and any
OpenAI-compatible API.

## Use

In page code it's `$llm.transcribe` (bound by the llm extension):

```js
const r = await $llm.transcribe.transcribeAsync({ model: "vultr/whisper-large-v3-turbo", audio: { name: "memo.mp3", data: base64Audio } })
r.text
```

Over HTTP (a superuser, or a token with the scope shown):

| Operation | HTTP | Body | Token scope |
|---|---|---|---|
| Transcribe | `POST /api/_c/llm.transcribe/v1/transcribe` | `{"model": "...", "audio": {"name": "memo.mp3", "data": "<base64>"}, "language": "en"}` | `llm` |
| Models | `GET /api/_c/llm.transcribe/v1/models` | `?provider=` (optional) | `llm:read` |

It answers `{"text", "language", "model", "usage"}`. The audio's name (or type) tells the provider its format.

Errors: `not_configured` (no providers), `unknown_model`, `not_supported`, `provider` (the cloud's own error), `timeout`.

From Go: `transcribev1.Contract.Must(app)` (from `pocketone.dev/ext/contracts/llm/transcribe/v1`).

## Provide

Implement `transcribev1.Transcribe` and provide it in `Register` (`transcribev1.Contract.Provide(app, impl)`). Route on the
`provider/` prefix, answer `not_supported` for a provider that can't do this kind, `unknown_model` for a missing model
or provider, and `provider` with the cloud's own message (never its key) when the cloud refuses. Fill `model` with the
full `provider/model` that answered, and `usage` with what the provider reports.

## Commands and APIs

Every operation is a REST endpoint, a `pocketone` command and an MCP tool, all generated from the contract and behind the same token scope check and hooks. See [Remote CLI](https://pocketone.dev/docs/features/remote), or the full [CLI](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/cli), [REST](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/rest) and [MCP](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/mcp) references.

### transcribe

Writes down what's said in the audio.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `POST /api/_c/llm.transcribe/v1/transcribe` |
| CLI | `pocketone remote llm transcribe --model <value> --audio <json> --language <value> --prompt <value> --options <json>` |
| MCP | `llm_transcribe_transcribe` |
| Token scope | `llm` |

| Input field | Flag | Type |
|---|---|---|
| `model` | `--model` | string |
| `audio` | `--audio` | json |
| `language` | `--language` | string |
| `prompt` | `--prompt` | string |
| `options` | `--options` | json |

### models

Lists the transcription models of every provider in Settings → LLM.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `GET /api/_c/llm.transcribe/v1/models` |
| CLI | `pocketone remote llm transcribe models --provider <value>` |
| MCP | `llm_transcribe_models` |
| Token scope | `llm:read` |

| Input field | Flag | Type |
|---|---|---|
| `provider` | `--provider` | string |
